title: Sometimes audio notification (Pipewire) freeze whole shell
line: A notification sound that gets stuck in the audio system no longer freezes the whole Plasma shell.
explanation: Notifications::playSoundHint() called libcanberra's ca_context_play_full() directly on plasmashell's GUI thread. When the audio server stalls (PipeWire/WirePlumber deadlock, or libpulse waiting on a stream), that call blocks forever (ALSA path) or 30 s per sound (pulse path), so panels, popups and the shell's D-Bus all stop. The change, MR !7266 applied unchanged, moves libcanberra context creation, playback and destruction to a dedicated worker thread, so only that thread waits for the audio server and shutdown never waits more than 2 s on it.

commits.message:
notificationmanager: play notification sounds on a worker thread

Notification sounds were played with libcanberra on the GUI thread, so a
stalled audio backend froze the whole shell. Playback now runs on its own
thread, based on MR !7266, so only that thread waits for the audio server.

BUG: 511472

media.caption: Master, pipewire-pulse stalled: 4 s after a sound notification and a plain one, neither popup has appeared.
With the fix, same steps: both popups appear at once while the sound waits in the background.
Master: the shell stays frozen while the sound call waits on the stalled audio server.
With the fix: popups appear and the shell keeps responding during the stall.
